$comment: The variants the team's tools know (D-130): tool/check_architecture.dart, tools/docs-check/check_ids.py and tools/reference-sim/levelcheck.py read them from here. A fifth variant is one more entry (docs/EXTENSIBILITY.md). gameId: the contract id; dart: the prefix of its classes, forbidden in the engine and the use cases; folder: its folder in packages/hexa_variants/lib/src/; prefix: its rules (RN-<prefix>-*) and stories (<prefix>-*); levels: how many bundled levels it must have in app/assets/levels/<gameId>/, or null if it is not played by levels.
